{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values per column:")
print(df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print(f"\nDuplicate rows: {df.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check value counts for key categorical columns
print(f"\nArm distribution:")
print(df['arm'].value_counts())
print(f"\nSeverity distribution:")
print(df['severity'].value_counts())
print(f"\nSex distribution:")
print(df['sex'].value_counts())

# Check the 'responded' variable
print(f"\nResponded distribution:")
print(df['responded'].value_counts())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"\nBiomarker baseline sentinel values (e.g., -999.0): {df['biomarker_baseline'].isin([-999.0]).sum()}")"}
